text: やーん　まけてる　ジンも　かっこいいのぉ

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb put right before a person or thing describes it, like 'who is...'. まけてる ジン = 'Jin who is losing'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says the action is going on; てる is its casual short form. まけてる = 'is losing'.

patterns.name: 〜の (sentence end)
patterns.explanation: の at the end of a statement gives a soft explaining tone, mostly used by women; dragging it out as のぉ sounds gushing. かっこいいのぉ = 'he's so cool'.
